title: Turn off lights in unused rooms
description: A starter example about noticing lighting that is not needed.
recommendation: Consider switching off lights when a room is unoccupied, where safe and appropriate.
impact: Potential savings depend on the lamp, operating hours, and household behavior; verify before quantifying.

title: Check appliance energy information
description: A starter example encouraging people to inspect information for their own appliance.
recommendation: Refer to the appliance label and manufacturer guidance when estimating its energy use.
impact: This improves the quality of an estimate; it does not guarantee a particular reduction.

title: Make use of daylight
description: A starter example about considering daylight before using electric lighting.
recommendation: Where practical, use available daylight while maintaining comfort, privacy, and safety.
impact: Any change depends on the room, season, and lighting habits; no savings amount is asserted.
